extracted.intended_audience: tourists and visitors planning a trip to Edinburgh
extracted.subtask_description: A general-purpose online travel guide for visitors to Edinburgh that lists attractions, tours, accommodation advice, itineraries, and practical information to prepare a trip.

rubrics_metrics.name: Information currency / update date
rubrics_metrics.description: All the information in this guide was updated in June 2025.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Show a clear last-updated date so readers know how current the recommendations are; keep content refreshed and note the update.

rubrics_metrics.name: Firsthand street-level research and photography
rubrics_metrics.description: This guide has been made by exploring each street, taking photos of every nook and cranny, and paying attention to each and every little detail to help you prepare your trip in the best way possible.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implied production standard: base content on on-the-ground exploration and photographic documentation to ensure accuracy and thoroughness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Guide structure: include key sections
rubrics_metrics.description: General Information; Top Attractions; Getting to Edinburgh; Getting around Edinburgh; Shopping; Where to Eat; Where to Stay; 2-Day Edinburgh Itinerary; Map; Day Trips; 3-Day Edinburgh Itinerary; Harry Potter in Edinburgh; Day Trip to Loch Ness.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A comprehensive travel guide should cover practical logistics, attractions, food, accommodation, itineraries, maps and notable themed content (e.g., Harry Potter sites, day trips).

rubrics_metrics.name: Activity/tour highlights and suitability
rubrics_metrics.description: Tour listings include short selling descriptions and suitability notes (examples: "Edinburgh Free Tour — perfect for any first-visitors to Edinburgh!"; "Edinburgh Castle Guided Tour — unmissable"; "Edinburgh Underground Ghost Tour — embark on a haunting journey").
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When listing tours/activities, include concise highlights, target audience or suitability, and a brief description of what to expect to help visitors choose.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accommodation booking advice
rubrics_metrics.description: If you still don’t have a hotel, hostel, or apartment booked, we recommend checking out the link below, where you’ll find all types of accommodation with the best rates guaranteed. If you book in advance, you’ll be able to get up to 75% discount and pay once you get to your destination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide clear booking recommendations: emphasize advance booking for discounts, highlight best-rate guarantees and pay-on-arrival options when available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Describe local atmosphere and unique characteristics
rubrics_metrics.description: Edinburgh has a rare charm with narrow and cobbled passageways (closes), dark corners where terrifying events have taken place, majestic buildings and gardens, fascinating museums, kind and open locals, rainy and windy weather that creates a mysterious and somber atmosphere, and ghost stories/hauntings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Convey the city's character through history, nicknames (e.g., "Auld Reekie"), weather, local customs and folklore to give readers a sense of place and expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Highlight free and budget-friendly attractions
rubrics_metrics.description: As well as countless ghost stories, Edinburgh also offers its visitors and locals a wide variety of attractions, including museums, most of which are free to visit.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Point out free-entry museums and other low-cost experiences to help budget-conscious travelers plan.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide itineraries and recommend time-limited passes
rubrics_metrics.description: The site offers 2-day and 3-day itineraries and promotes products like the "Royal Edinburgh Ticket" to enjoy attractions for 48 hours.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include suggested day-by-day itineraries and recommend passes/tickets (with clear timeframes) to help visitors maximize short stays.

rubrics_metrics.name: Solicit reader feedback for corrections
rubrics_metrics.description: If you see any errors or anything we should change, we would be delighted to hear from you.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Encourage readers to report errors or suggest changes as part of maintaining guide accuracy and currency.
